purpose: Drug->pi3k_mtor axis evidence assembled ONLY from grounded in-repo sources. Numbers/claims traced to existing receipts; no fabricated GDSC2/PRISM rows.

alpelisib.grounded_claim: SOLAR-1 (Phase III, n=572, PIK3CA-mut HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer): alpelisib+fulvestrant PFS 11.0 vs 5.7 mo (HR=0.65, p<0.001); FDA-approved.
alpelisib.context_caveat: Evidence base is BREAST cancer (PIK3CA-mut), not ovarian. Applying to OV is extrapolation and must be labeled as such.

capivasertib.grounded_claim: CAPItello-291 (Phase III): capivasertib+fulvestrant PFS benefit in PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered breast cancer.
capivasertib.context_caveat: Breast cancer evidence; OV use is extrapolation.

inavolisib.grounded_claim: Listed among validated PI3K-pathway agents (alpelisib, capivasertib, inavolisib) in PIK3CA-mutant in-vitro sensitivity receipt.

everolimus.grounded_claim: JAX KB: PTEN-LOF -> Everolimus (mTOR inhibitor), tier B, sensitivity, endometrial cancer.
everolimus.context_caveat: KB association is PTEN-LOF/endometrial; OV use is extrapolation.
